claim_rules.synthetic_tested: Executable synthetic or fixture-based check only. Not independent review, not real-project validation, not manufacturer qualification, not NFPA certification.
claim_rules.reference_verified: Requires independent expected reference cases and versioned report.
claim_rules.product_qualified: Requires reviewed manufacturer sources and named product envelope evidence.
claim_rules.workflow_validated: Requires independent held-out real-project benchmark with predeclared targets.
claim_rules.purpose_released: Requires resolved release assessment and authorized reviewer decision for an explicit purpose.
